mapper.insert: INSERT INTO event_failure_record ( id, channel, original_topic, dlt_topic, message_key, payload, error, status, replay_count, failed_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{channel}, #{originalTopic}, #{dltTopic}, #{messageKey}, #{payload}, #{error}, 'NEW', 0, #{failedAt}, NOW(), NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE error = VALUES(error), status = 'NEW', updated_at = NOW()
mapper.update: UPDATE event_failure_record SET replay_count = replay_count + 1, last_replay_status = CASE WHEN #{success} THEN 'SUCCESS' ELSE 'FAILED' END, last_replay_at = NOW(), last_replay_message = #{message}, status = CASE WHEN #{success} THEN 'REPLAYED' ELSE 'NEW' END, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE event_failure_record SET status = 'IGNORED', last_replay_status = 'IGNORED', last_replay_at = NOW(), last_replay_message = #{message}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT channel, status, COUNT(1) AS count FROM event_failure_record GROUP BY channel, status
